content.json:
## Genesys WebRTC Provisioning
Operationele gebeurtenissen uit de Function App. De actuele gebruikersstatus staat in WebRtcState en de beveiligde status-API.

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith "webrtc_event "
| extend e=parse_json(substring(Message,13))
| summarize Aantal=count() by Event=tostring(e.event)
| order by Aantal desc
content.title: Gebeurtenissen

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith "webrtc_event "
| extend e=parse_json(substring(Message,13))
| where tostring(e.event) in ("user_failed","scan_failed","poison_message")
| project TimeGenerated,Event=tostring(e.event),UserId=tostring(e.user_id),Code=tostring(e.code)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Fouten

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith "webrtc_event "
| extend e=parse_json(substring(Message,13))
| where tostring(e.event) == "scan_completed"
| project TimeGenerated,Eligible=toint(e.eligible),Scheduled=toint(e.scheduled),DryRun=tobool(e.dry_run)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Laatste scans

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith "webrtc_event "
| extend e=parse_json(substring(Message,13))
| where tostring(e.event) == "backlog_snapshot"
| project TimeGenerated,Pending=toint(e.pending),Blocked=toint(e.blocked),OldestSeconds=toint(e.oldest_pending_age_seconds)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Achterstand
